card_lines: TOP: buy Salt Lick levels: Refinery Speed +4, Total Damage dealt. +30, Cooking Mastery EXP gain, a feature unlo +5.
Still to max: Refinery Speed 71/100, Total Damage dealt. 152/250, Cooking Mastery EXP gain, a feature unlo 30/100.

upgrades.desc: Samples taken for the 3D printer are +10% bigger!
+4 Obol storage slots per upgrade! Circle, Square, Hexagon, then Sparkle, in that order.
+142% Refinery Speed for all cycle types. In other words, cycles take less time.
+20% Class EXP and Skill EXP. Not really sure what those blobulytes do with these souls...
+20 Max level for talent books from the library. RNG be with you!
+100% Liquid rate and Capacity for all liquids in Alchemy.
+50% Points Earned during Worship Tower Defense from killing monsters.
+10% Movement Speed. Doesn't work if you're above 170% move speed already.
+30% Multikill Rate for all worlds. All of them!
+30% Cooking Mastery EXP gain, a feature unlocked via Rift 61 deep in World 4.
